name: Dataverse security roles
short_description: Sets of privileges in Dataverse, such as create, read, write, delete, append, append to, assign and share, each defined per table with an access level or depth; roles are additive.

evidence.quote: Business units, security roles, teams, record ownership, column security, hierarchy sharing
Those permissions come from Dataverse security roles.
Dataverse uses role-based security. You don't assign permissions to individual users one at a time. You create roles.
